introHtml: Custom rainbow drawstring backpacks bring a burst of color to any event or promotion. Unlike standard solid-color bags, the rainbow pattern stands out at pride parades, summer camps, and school spirit days, making your brand instantly recognizable. These lightweight backpacks are perfect for giveaways where visibility matters, and they can be screen printed or embroidered with your logo for a lasting impression.
